messages.subject: International Executive Profile | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ravindra,

Abloom Global's international leadership and executive-search platform makes this a relevant introduction for senior cross-border mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a major natural-resources operation.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where institutional relationships, regulatory execution, stakeholder confidence and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for broader global assignments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
